*metavect.txt*  MetaVect filetype support                      *metavect*

MetaVect is a functional vector-graphics language under development. This
plugin provides filetype detection, syntax highlighting, indentation, and
TeX/LaTeX integration for MetaVect sources (`.mv`, `.mvec`, `.mvct`).
The compiler lexer (frontend/Lexer.d) is authoritative; the editor files
mirror it on a best-effort basis.

CONTENTS                                             *metavect-contents*
  1. Filetype .............. |metavect-filetype|
  2. Syntax ................ |metavect-syntax|
  3. Indentation ........... |metavect-indent|
  4. TeX/LaTeX ............. |metavect-tex|
  5. Commands .............. |metavect-commands|
  6. Install ............... |metavect-install|

1. FILETYPE                                          *metavect-filetype*
Files ending in `.mv`, `.mvec`, or `.mvct` are detected as MetaVect
(see extern/Vim/ftdetect/MetaVect.vim). The filetype sets:
  - `commentstring` to `-- %s`
  - `comments` to nested `{-` `-}` blocks plus `--` lines
  - `suffixesadd` to `.mvct,.mv,.mvec`
  - `matchpairs` to `(:),[:],{:}`
  - `makeprg` to `mvect --check-syntax %` with a matching `errorformat`
    (`file:line:col: error: message`) when `mvect` is on PATH

2. SYNTAX                                            *metavect-syntax*
Groups (see extern/Vim/syntax/MetaVect.vim):
  mvKeyword ...... `let in fun fn type forall if then else match with`
                   `module import export`
  mvBoolean ...... `true false` (boolean literals)
  mvType ......... `Int Float Bool String Unit Path Color Vector Matrix`
                   (conventional names; the lexer sees identifiers)
  mvNumber ....... integers `42`, floats `1.25 1e3 4.5E-2`
  mvNumberError .. lexer-invalid numbers (`12abc`, `1e`, `1.0E-`)
  mvString ....... `"..."` (one line; escapes `\n \r \t \" \\`)
  mvStringEscape . valid escape inside a string
  mvStringError .. invalid escape (`\q`) inside a string
  mvOperator ..... `-> => :: == != <= >= && || + - * / = ! < > | & : .`
  mvDelimiter .... `( ) [ ] { } , ;` (`()` is two delimiters here; only
                   the parser reads the pair as a unit literal)
  mvLineComment .. `--` to end of line (`x--1` is `x` plus a comment)
  mvBlockComment . nestable `{- ... -}`

3. INDENTATION                                        *metavect-indent*
`GetMetaVectIndent()` (extern/Vim/indent/MetaVect.vim) is lexical only:
  - one level per net open delimiter on the previous code line
  - one extra level after a line ending in `=`, `=>`, `then`, `else`, `in`
  - dedent when the new line starts with `]` `}` `)`
Strings and comments are stripped before counting, so their brackets do
not indent. Continuation example: >
  export size : Int = let base : Int = 20 in
      if base > 0 then identity(base + 2 * 3) else 0

4. TEX/LATEX                                          *metavect-tex*
  - LaTeX package: `\usepackage{metavect}` provides `\MetaVectInput`,
    `\MetaVectInputOpt`, the `metavectcode` listing, and
    `\MetaVectVersion` (currently 0.1.0). Source: extern/LaTeX/metavect.dtx.
  - Plain/LaTeX input: `\input{MetaVect.tex}` (extern/TeX) defines
    `\MetaVectVersion` and `\MetaVectGraphic`.
  - Example document: extern/TeX/Build.tex shows both inclusion and a
    `listings` code sample.

5. COMMANDS                                        *metavect-commands*
`:make` runs the syntax check on the current buffer (when configured). >

6. INSTALL                                          *metavect-install*
Add `extern/Vim` to your runtime path: >
  set runtimepath+=/path/to/MetaVect/extern/Vim
<
